title: Privileged provisioning graph and continuous review automation
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build an end-to-end system that computes an entity-level provisioning graph for privileged roles, ties SCIM and SSO events to that graph, and automates periodic review evidence exports. Goal is to reduce manual audit work and meet retention requirements for access reviews across private and dedicated deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Provisioning graph generator produces a snapshot within SLA (under 90s for orgs with <10k identities)
SCIM change events are ingested and attributed to graph edges in near-real-time (max 2-minute lag)
Periodic review runbook produces a signed evidence bundle (CSV + JSON manifest) and is uploadable to compliance S3/Drive with retention metadata
Console UI shows reviewer assignments and deltas with clear justification links
SAML/SSO sessions can be correlated to a provisioning edge for at least 90% of privileged elevations in the last 30 days
Automated alerts created when privileged role membership exceeds policy thresholds (configurable per-tenant)
tasks: Design graph schema and storage model (decide between time-series vs. delta-only storage)
Implement SCIM ingestion consumer and change-annotator
Add SSO session correlation pipeline (link auth events to provisioning edges)
Expose review API to trigger evidence bundle generation
Wire evidence export to tenant-specific retention and residency metadata
Console: add review workflow UI and history viewer
Create e2e test harness and synthetic tenant generator for compliance tests
Run security review and threat model for data residency and retention handling

decisions: Use append-only edge log with weekly materialized snapshots to provide tamper-evident history and make evidence bundles compact
Store per-tenant residency and retention tags on each snapshot to satisfy jurisdictional export rules
Correlate SSO events by canonicalized user identifier (SCIM id preferred; fallback to email with confidence score)
Evidence bundles will contain both human-readable CSV and machine-checked JSON manifest and be signed with platform key; tenant may re-sign before long-term retention exports
risks: Edge cases where SCIM providers batch updates may create large delta spikes; need backpressure and bucketed snapshotting
SSO providers that do not expose stable identifiers will reduce correlation coverage; mitigation: add heuristics and surface confidence metrics to reviewers
Retention/residency metadata complexity increases export plumbing and KMS calls which could impact export throughput
Performance regressions if snapshotting runs concurrently with heavy serving traffic on Dedicated pools — require isolation
implementation_notes: Graph storage: start with Cassandra time-partitioned table for append-only edges; materialized snapshots exported to s3-like store
Ingestion: use Kafka topic per-tenant for SCIM events; consumer creates edge records and emits tombstones for deprovision events
SSO correlation: enrich auth events in stream processor with mapping table; audit trail includes mapping rationale
Evidence generation: lambda-style job that fetches snapshot+events, composes bundle, signs, and pushes to tenant export location with retention tags
Telemetry: add metrics for snapshot time, SCIM lag, correlation coverage, and evidence bundle generation duration
